description:
OSGi bundle wrapping the Direct-BT library: it embeds the Direct-BT fat jar (Java API + platform
    natives), declares the natives via Bundle-NativeCode so the framework loads them, and adds a small
    activator so consumers (e.g. the openHAB Direct-BT binding) can use Direct-BT in an OSGi runtime.
    This bundle is versioned independently of the embedded Direct-BT release (see directbt.version).
